# dcd-asset-bank

> Asset bank of the dynamic-commercial-decks skill (v0.7.0): 368 cards over animated SVG scenes, arcs, templates, per-vertical knowledge, neutral examples and icon sets, in Spanish with English summaries. Search with search.py (BM25) or graphify-out/graph.json.
